articles.original_summary: From September 14 to 16, Corey Hogan, Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, attended the G20 Energy Abundance Ministerial Meeting in Houston, Texas, where he joined energy ministers to discuss energy security, affordability, investment and innovation and to reinforce Canada’s role as a reliable and trusted global energy supplier. The G20’s membership represents about two-thirds of the world’s population, over 89 percent of world GDP and over 79 percent of global trade.
